scope: Bounded semantic/data-lineage/document-command review of 5 objectives, 30 public reference pairs, and 5 cards. No Kiro generation, model training, or runtime code behavior tested.
semantic_answer_verdict: All 30 stated preferences are supported by visible synthetic contracts; identified lineage/resume wording findings were corrected and rechecked. This is not a claim of runtime or learned performance.

findings.finding: Same two-branch success/failure scenario with only group/attempt renaming and partial-result policy reversal had different families. Each card explicitly treats the other condition as its counterexample.
findings.required_change: Use common family/origin/leakage group; do not count as independent underlying scenarios.
findings.resolution: Both now family v3-ref.or-auto-fanin.f04 in objective pack and flat rows; author regenerated cards.

findings.finding: One required branch running versus both terminal is the explicit counterfactual pair of the same two-branch collection scenario; group/attempt names differ but not underlying setup.
findings.required_change: Preserve common lineage for these two variants; no new independent-family count from state flip/rename alone.
findings.resolution: OR-AUTO-FANIN-REF-01/02 now share v3-ref.or-auto-fanin.f01; flat rows retain same origin/leakage.

findings.finding: Offline operation locally persisted/queued and unseen by server matches existing public reference scenario. New operation label and output JSON do not make a new independent source.
findings.required_change: Preserve legacy family OR-MOBILE-01-REF-F001 and derived_from, or at minimum shared origin/leakage group across formats.
findings.resolution: Legacy OR-MOBILE-01-REF-F001 added as origin/leakage with derived_from OR-MOBILE-01-REF-001; row remains reference-only.

findings.finding: Completed K with same payload and preserved result is existing server-idempotency story; changing invoice44 to generic R and selecting database objective does not make independent data.
findings.required_change: Share legacy OR-SERVER-01-REF-F001 family/origin/leakage group with derived_from across domains.
findings.resolution: Legacy OR-SERVER-01-REF-F001 added as origin/leakage with derived_from OR-SERVER-01-REF-001, preserving cross-domain lineage.

findings.finding: Verified applied-ACK/hash strengthens existing public scenario where applied Q remains in local queue after restart. Safe conservative handling is to preserve source lineage, not count the added evidence as a wholly independent seed.
findings.required_change: Retain legacy OR-MOBILE-01-REF-F003 origin/derived_from or shared leakage group.
findings.resolution: Legacy OR-MOBILE-01-REF-F003 added as origin/leakage with derived_from OR-MOBILE-01-REF-003.

findings.finding: Existing preparation directory is currently described as an unfinished attempt with a handle, but prepare only creates files and does not launch a model process. A directory does not imply a live resumable process.
findings.required_change: Use wait/resume only for a real recorded task/process handle. If only preparation/draft/review exists, continue that stage without inventing a handle or starting duplicate work.
findings.resolution: All five cards now explicitly distinguish existing directory from a recorded actual process handle; file-only preparation continues draft/review without invented wait.

verified_boundaries: Outbox at-least-once delivery is distinguished from consumer completion and exactly-once; atomicity/lease guarantees are explicitly hypothetical input contracts.
DB ownership/CAS choices are next-action decisions under stated primitives, not assertions that a real production lock alone guarantees fencing/exactly-once.
Mobile accepted versus applied, operation identity, payload identity, and terminal failure have explicit separate consequences.
Functional acceptance choices preserve prompt-specific requirements; no extra feature or implementation was required in chosen.
Command flags for prepare/validate/blind and blind.key.json match the observed sets.py argparse and blind output naming; commands were not executed as runtime/training tests.
All examples remain reference-only with training_allowed=false; no actual learning result claimed.
open_runtime_questions: Native consumer binding, real wait-tool behavior, generation quality, and learned effects remain outside this documentation review.
